title: Trump's Venezuela Money Grab, Problem Falling Asleep in Meetings & Unarmed Woman Killed by ICE
text: Trump’s Venezuela Money Grab, Problem Falling Asleep in Meetings & Unarmed Woman Killed by ICEOne year ago today the fires that went on to devastate Altadena and the Pacific Palisades ignited, Trump is on day five of his side job running Venezuela, it’s DEFINITELY not a brazen money grab, it just so happens Venezuela won the most Miss Universe titles after Trump bought the pageant in 1996, Trump is considering military action to acquire Greenland, the White House has been calling in reinforcements (Lindsey Graham) to convince MAGA that all of this is a good idea, an ICE Agent shot and killed an unarmed woman during an operation in Minneapolis today, RFK Jr declared war on unhealthy and processed foods, Dr. Oz unveiled looser guidelines for drinking alcohol, and Trump tries to convince us that he’s not falling asleep in meetings, he's just blinking!
